title: The Rotavirus Vaccine Story: From Discovery to the Eventual Control of Rotavirus Disease.
ehr_evidence: Narrative review synthesizing published clinical trial data, surveillance reports, and historical literature on rotavirus vaccine development and implementation.
summary: Narrative review of the history, development, efficacy, global implementation, and future directions of rotavirus vaccines.
population: Children worldwide, primarily under 5 years of age
limitations: Relies on published literature and historical data rather than original primary analysis
data_availability_statement: Supplementary materials are available at The Journal of Infectious Diseases online. Consisting of data provided by the authors to benefit the reader, the posted materials are not copyedited and are the sole responsibility of the authors, so questions or comments should be addressed to the corresponding author.
